caption: The notification sent to translators when the original is corrected
preconditions: A French translation of the seeded published item CEASEFIRE-TALKS ('Talks on Dunmarra ceasefire to resume next week, mediators say', World desk output) exists in World / Working, with its headline changed to 'Les pourparlers sur le cessez-le-feu de Dunmarra reprendront la semaine prochaine'. The shot 'translating-content/authoring-header-translated-from' creates it; otherwise create it by API: POST /api/archive/translate {"guid": <CEASEFIRE-TALKS guid>, "language": "fr", "desk": <World desk id>}, then PATCH the headline. Only one French translation must exist: restore and re-seed before re-running, or every run adds another translation.
marenholt (Editor role, has translate, publish and correct) is a member of desk World; add her in the desk settings if not

marenholt opened the French translation, made any edit (e.g. a body sentence in French) and published it, so she is the last editor of the published translation. World is a production desk and the seeded subscriber accepts it, as for the seeded published items
Afterwards admin corrected the original CEASEFIRE-TALKS: World desk output > open the item > Correct, change one word in the body, open the Send to / Publish panel and click 'Send correction'
These steps can also run by API: PATCH /api/archive/publish/<translation id> as marenholt, then PATCH /api/archive/correct/<original id> as admin with a body change

The French headline set by authoring-header-translated-from is 82 characters and the Story profile allows 64, so the publish fails with 'HEADLINE is too long'. Publish with a shorter headline: PATCH /api/archive/publish/<translation id> as marenholt with {"headline": "Dunmarra : reprise des pourparlers sur le cessez-le-feu"}, then PATCH /api/archive/correct/<original id> as admin with a body change (done this way on 2026-10-14).
steps: click the button with aria-label 'View notifications' (button[aria-label="View notifications"])
move the mouse away from the list
notes: Activity 'translated:changed' is sent by superdesk-core apps/publish/content/correct.py send_translation_notifications to the original_creator and version_creator of every published item with the original's translation_id. Text in scripts/core/menu/notifications/views/notifications.html: '<user> changed the following original item. Please make sure to update the corresponding translated item accordingly <slugline>'. The 'marenholt' user is not in the capture users map; it falls back to username = password = marenholt (seeded). Close the pane afterwards. An email is also sent; the e2e stack does not deliver it, so it is not shown.
